diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because check C1 passed in all rollouts despite being linked to decisive facts PF1 and PF2, which were never accessed. The model defaulted to an 'approved' decision based on the shared public facts (S1-S4) without needing the specific constraints (lab sessions or meeting times) provided by the hidden information.
